messages:
olivia_fp&a: Partner flagged unexpected charges on INV-2026-0515 after we ran a pricing experiment last month. They say the experimental discount applied to marketplace-managed SKUs incorrectly.

sam_billing: Which partner and what's the invoice line?

olivia_fp&a: Partner: NorthBridge Channel (CH-4122). Invoice snippet:
INV-2026-0515 | SKU: NB-MARK-STD | Usage: 95,000 units | Rate applied: $0.018/unit (experimental) | Amount: $1,710.00
Expected baseline rate for marketplace = $0.02/unit -> expected $1,900.00 -> difference $190.00 (we underbilled, partner says we should have kept baseline)

ben_partnerops: We ran a temporary promo for direct customers last month and intended to exclude marketplace/reseller SKUs, but the promo key leaked into the global pricing rules during rollout. Looks like the mediation picked up promo_tag=EXP-APR which matched NB-MARK-STD.

rachel_recon: Billing ledger shows applied_pricing_source = experimental_ruleset.ledger_note = EXP-APR. I can prepare a correction row but need partner preference: credit or invoice adjustment?

billingbot: Invoice INV-2026-0515 created by billing-pipeline v2.4.1 at 2026-05-05T03:12:02Z. Pricing rule EXP-APR applied to 23 invoice lines.

olivia_fp&a: Partner prefers invoice adjustment rather than credit. They want clean bookkeeping.

sam_billing: Finance policy: for marketplace/reseller billing, prefer invoice reissue when experiment caused pricing drift and partner requests it. We'll need engineering to reprocess affected invoices and accounting sign-off. GL provisional: 4335 (Revenue Corrections).

ben_partnerops: I'll open ENGOPS-5120 to add a safety flag preventing promo rules from applying to marketplace channel ids. Also add an audit log for ruleset matches.

rachel_recon: I'll add detailed ledger exports for the 23 lines and compute totals. Preliminary total impact = $3,420 underbilled across partners. Adding to billing-reconcile sheet now.

sam_billing: Ok finance approves reissue workflow for CH-4122 once engineering confirms safe replay. No credits until reissue complete.

olivia_fp&a: Notifying partner AE and confirming they want reissued invoice for CH-4122 only. Will update thread once AE responds.

billingbot: ENGOPS-5120 created. Billing-reconcile link: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/REDACTED
